findings.evidence: notify him by email
findings.rationale: The pronoun 'him' has an ambiguous antecedent and could refer to the Librarian, the Member, or the Guarantor.

findings.evidence: TBD minutes
findings.rationale: The password-reset token expiration duration is left as an unresolved placeholder ('TBD minutes').

findings.evidence: user-friendly Member dashboard that is easy to navigate and loads rapidly on standard connections
findings.rationale: Qualitative terms ('user-friendly', 'easy to navigate', 'loads rapidly', 'standard connections') lack objective, measurable acceptance criteria.

findings.evidence: at most TBD consecutive times
findings.rationale: The maximum number of consecutive loan renewals is specified as an unresolved placeholder ('TBD').

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt
findings.rationale: Only the successful validation path is specified; behavior when item eligibility validation fails is omitted.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number of active hold requests
findings.rationale: References 'the allowed maximum number' of active hold requests without specifying the numeric limit.

findings.evidence: borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: Allows up to 8 physical items checked out simultaneously, contradicting SD-009 which enforces a maximum of 5 physical items.

findings.evidence: 21 calendar days from the checkout timestamp
findings.rationale: Sets the standard loan period for circulating print books to 21 calendar days, contradicting SD-010 which specifies 14 calendar days.

findings.evidence: self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification
findings.rationale: Allows unverified visitors to self-register with only an email and check out books without ID verification, contradicting SD-001 which requires Librarian verification of government-issued photo ID and recording full name, email, and phone number.

findings.evidence: remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold
findings.rationale: Requires reserved items to remain held indefinitely until explicitly cancelled, contradicting SD-011 which automatically cancels uncollected holds after 72 hours.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Repeated 'and/or' coordination leaves unclear which combination of the three actions is mandatory when an item becomes 7 days overdue.

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded
findings.rationale: Passive construction omits the actor or role responsible for reviewing, approving, and recording overdue fine waiver requests.

findings.evidence: if appropriate
findings.rationale: The hedging clause 'if appropriate' leaves the condition for dispatching SMS due-date alerts undefined and subjective.

findings.evidence: before the due date
findings.rationale: Omits the specific lead time (numeric value and time unit) before the due date when SMS alerts must be dispatched.

findings.evidence: for TBD years
findings.rationale: The retention period for payment receipts is left as an unresolved placeholder ('TBD years').

findings.evidence: $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap on accumulated fines
findings.rationale: Specifies an overdue fine of $1.25 USD/day with no cap, contradicting SD-019 which sets the fine at $0.50 USD/day capped at $20.00 USD per item.

findings.evidence: renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: Permits item renewal regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance, contradicting SD-020 which blocks renewals when unpaid fines exceed $5.00 USD.

findings.evidence: each Patron's active loan count and enforce the 5-item borrowing limit on the Patron profile screen
findings.rationale: Introduces the term 'Patron' instead of the established term 'Member' used throughout the SRS (e.g., SD-001, SD-009), and references a 5-item limit matching SD-009 that also conflicts with SD-015's 8-item limit.

findings.evidence: return search results quickly even when many users are querying
findings.rationale: The terms 'quickly' and 'many users' lack concrete latency and concurrency metrics.

findings.evidence: where possible
findings.rationale: The phrase 'where possible' creates an unspecified optionality condition for highlighting matched query terms.

findings.evidence: sufficient ISBN matching accuracy and acceptable response times
findings.rationale: The terms 'sufficient' and 'acceptable' are subjective and unquantified.

findings.evidence: efficiently process large batch MARC21 files without noticeable system slowdown
findings.rationale: The terms 'efficiently', 'large', and 'noticeable system slowdown' lack measurable throughput, file-size, and performance bounds.

findings.evidence: the Catalog Service shall detect the active references
findings.rationale: States only that active references are detected when deleting a bibliographic record, omitting the required action or consequence (such as rejecting deletion or returning an error).

findings.evidence: at TBD intervals
findings.rationale: The database backup schedule interval is left as an unresolved placeholder ('TBD intervals').

findings.evidence: important administrative actions in a timely manner and retain them for an appropriate period
findings.rationale: The terms 'important', 'in a timely manner', and 'an appropriate period' fail to define which actions are audited, the logging latency, and the retention duration.

findings.evidence: the Failover Manager shall log event FAILOVER-01
findings.rationale: Specifies only logging 'FAILOVER-01' when the primary database node is unreachable for over 10 seconds, omitting the actual failover or recovery action.

findings.evidence: adequate transport security and clear error messages
findings.rationale: The terms 'adequate' and 'clear' are subjective and do not specify concrete security protocols or error message requirements.

findings.evidence: accept any Member password of at least 8 characters
findings.rationale: Accepts any password of at least 8 characters, contradicting SD-002 which requires at least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and numeric characters.

findings.evidence: 60 minutes of user inactivity
findings.rationale: Keeps authenticated web portal sessions active for 60 minutes of inactivity, contradicting SD-004 which terminates sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.

findings.evidence: encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt and retrieve forgotten passwords
findings.rationale: Requires reversible AES-256 encryption and administrator password decryption/retrieval, contradicting SD-003 which mandates one-way bcrypt hashing and prohibits storing plaintext passwords.
